# KafkaConsumerStalled

<!-- GENERATED by monitoring/dashgen from internal/rules (make alerts). Do not edit. -->

| Severity | Component | Dashboard | for (production / demo) |
|---|---|---|---|
| warning | consumer | [kafka-lag](http://grafana.localhost:8080/d/kafka-lag/) | 10m / 1m |

**Summary:** Consumer group <group_id> is stalled on <topic_name>

Group <group_id> has members and lag on <topic_name> but committed no progress for 5 minutes. The application is stuck (blocked handler, poison message, paused consumer) while still holding its partitions.

## Impact

Nothing is processed for the affected topic while the group still holds its partitions, so no other instance takes over.

## Diagnosis

1. Kafka · Consumer Groups & Lag → Stalled consumers table and Group state.
2. Application logs (Kafka Lab · Logs) of the group's pods: blocked handler, poison message retried forever, paused consumer.

## Mitigation

- Restart the stuck instance; move poison messages to a DLQ.
- Lab: disable the 'Silent Failure' knob on the controlboard.

## Expression

```promql
(kminion_kafka_consumer_group_topic_lag > 0) unless on (kafka_cluster, group_id, topic_name) (kafka:consumer_group_topic_consume_rate:rate5m > 0) and on (kafka_cluster, group_id) (kminion_kafka_consumer_group_members > 0)
```
